ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT BYANDBETWEEN DENISE M.ROBINSON AND 1346PACIFIC ST LLC Dated as of the Znt day of De combu, 2019 BLOCK:1208 LOTS: 22 and 23 COUNTY: Kings RECORDANDRETURNTO: David Fainkich, Esq. 25 Reeve Place Brooklyn, NY 11218

ZONING LOT ANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT is made as of this Znd_ day of eeeml, 2019 (this “Agreement"),by and among DENISE M. ROBINSON, having an address at 1348 Pacific Street, Brooklyn, New York 11216 (“Transferor") and 1346 PACIFIC ST LLC, a New York-State limited liability company, having an address at 490 Kings Highway, Brooklyn, New York 11223 (*"Transferee"). RECITALS: A. Transferor is the owner in fee simple of that certain parcel of land lying and being in the City and State of New York, Kings County, designated as Lot 23 in Block 1208 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County (the “Tax Map") and known by the street address of 1348 Pacific Street, Brooklyn, New York, which land is more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (the “Transferor's Land"), together Transferor's Land and Transferor's Improvements herein being referred to collectively as "Transferor'sPremises.' B.  Transferee is the owner in fee simple of that certain parcel of land lying and being in the City and State of New York, Kings County designated as Lot 22 in Block 1208 on the Tax Map and known by the street address of 1346 Pacific Street, Brooklyn, New York, which land is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (the“Transferee's Land"), together with the improvements thereon, if any, (said existing improvements being herein referred to as “Transferee's Existing Building"), together with any future replacements thereof or additions thereto whether made by Transferee or Transferee's successors or assigns, and including without limitation, Transferee's New Building (as hereinafter defined); the Transferee's Land, Transferee's Existing Building and Transferee's New Building herein being referred to collectively as “Transferee's Premises. C.  Transferee intends to construct a new building (said new building and improvements, together with any related improvements, additions, renovations, alterations, restorations, repairs and reconstructions thereto whether made by Transferee or Transferee's successors or assigns, herein being referred to collectively as "Transferee's New Building") consistent with the rights afforded it pursuant to this Agreement. D. The certification by Transferee's architect certifies that the Transferor's Subject Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are approximately nine hundred twenty (920) square feet.
